page: Microsoft Azure E20d_v5 is a memory-optimized server instance from the EDv5 family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8370C processor running at 2.8 GHz, delivering 20 dedicated vCPUs across 10 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 160.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Additionally, it features 768 GB of local SSD storage and operates on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

Benchmark results place the E20d_v5 in the average performance tier for most compute and memory operations, with a notable exception in memory efficiency. The instance achieved a strong Passmark memory score of 2801.06, placing it in the top 25% of tested systems. Memory bandwidth tests show read-only speeds of 1042.6 GB/sec for small cached blocks and 112.59 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. CPU-bound benchmarks, such as Geekbench multi-core (11036.0) and Passmark CPU (25547.1), reflect steady, mid-range processing capabilities.

While the instance excels in memory-intensive tasks, it exhibits performance limitations in heavy computational workloads. For instance, large-scale LLM inference using a 70B parameter model is poor, yielding only 4.19 tokens per second for prompt processing. However, the combination of 160.0 GB of RAM, a 768 GB local SSD, and strong memory performance makes this instance highly cost-efficient for memory-bound workloads. It is well-suited for database operations, caching layers like Redis, data processing, and memory-intensive enterprise applications.
